name: CsvUtility
src_typeComment: Minimal, dependency-free CSV reader/writer — handles quoted fields (commas/newlines inside quotes, escaped "" for a literal quote), which a naive string.Split(',') gets wrong. Both Excel and Google Sheets read/write this exact format natively, so this is the practical way to move data between a spreadsheet and Unity without needing a binary .xlsx parsing library.

src_members.sig: public static List<string[]> ReadFile(string path) => Parse(File.ReadAllText(path))
src_members.name: ReadFile

src_members.sig: public static void WriteFile(string path, IReadOnlyList<string[]> rows) => File.WriteAllText(path, ToCsv(rows))
src_members.name: WriteFile
